objective.title: Objective
objective.body: Graphic designer with 5+ years of experience blending creative design and marketing strategy. Skilled in crafting brand identities, digital content, and campaigns that drive engagement and align with business goals.

Price overlays, promo frames, and seasonal sale creatives
Interior styling visuals aligned to Rainbow brand palette
Fast-turnaround posts for launches, stock arrivals, and events

items.description: Teaches Graphic Design C3 — guiding students through Adobe workflows, layout fundamentals, branding exercises, and portfolio-ready project briefs.
bullets: Lesson plans for Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign basics
Class critiques, rubrics, and practical studio assignments
Student showcase materials and certification prep support

items.description: Produced marketing collateral, social content, and brand assets for hospitality and digital clients across the Maldives.
